core_obligations: Assume (1) and choose a surjective etale V -> Y with V a scheme (proof lines 933-935).
Write down the square of topological spaces and record the openness and surjectivity of its horizontal arrows and the surjectivity of the comparison map (proof lines 936-947).
Conclude that |Z x_Y X| -> |Z| is open, and note that the converse is immediate from the definitions (proof lines 948-951).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a representable morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over S, universal openness in the representable sense is equivalent to |Z x_Y X| -> |Z| being open for every morphism Z -> Y (source lines 920-930). The proof is the topological square argument: pick a surjective etale V -> Y with V a scheme, use that V x_Y X -> V is universally open as a morphism of schemes, and observe that in the square comparing |V x_Y X| -> |V| and |Z x_Y X| -> |Z| the horizontal arrows are open and surjective and the comparison map |V x_Y X| -> |V| x_{|Z|} |Z x_Y X| is surjective, so openness of the left vertical arrow forces openness of the right one; the converse is immediate from the definitions.
